purpose: Run the same native projection cases with fewer crossings of the worker and database observer pipes.
requirements: Record each attempted input, constructed response, and individual checked observation in their scheduled order.
Match every batch response to its request by position. Reject missing or excess responses as a failure.
Send the rendered SQL of every constructed case to the native database. Reuse the same fixture and comparison contract.
Keep the original timeout, seeds, exploration budgets, expected identities, observations and exclusions.
The replay uses the same request orders and must consume every recorded worker and database response.
trust: The observer prepares and executes each SQL request separately on the disposable native database. The Python controller decides the outcome of every comparison.
